errata.name: Pokémon Power
text: Poison, Paralysis, Confusion, Sleep, Burn ... are now all called Special Conditions and they all will shut off Pokemon Powers unless a Pokemon Power states that it won't normally be shut off by these Conditions.
errata.change: Every Special Condition shuts off a Pokémon Power, so a Power printed as stopping when its Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed also stops when it is Poisoned or Burned, as later cards print.
